required_extractor_behavior: Cache downloaded source files by cryptographic hash.
Record model initialization time, forecast valid time, available_at and ingested_at separately.
Extract nearest valid water nodes plus a small local neighborhood rather than relying on one arbitrary node.
Preserve surface versus depth-resolved fields; do not label model salinity/current as direct observation.
Compute shoreline-normal and shoreline-parallel current components from documented local shoreline orientation.
Retain node coordinates, vertical coordinate/depth interpretation and model-cycle provenance.
Backtest extraction against confirmed events and matched controls before assigning positive production weight.
guardrail: NGOFS2 is model guidance. It must remain distinct from CO-OPS observations, direct current meters and local bottom sensors.
